summary: Backend-only testing of Vinayaka Seva. Built pytest suite covering health, auth (invalid/valid tokens), roles, festival config, seed+dashboard, tasks CRUD (create/list/patch/comment/delete), donations, expenses (create + approve RBAC), announcements, events, members role update (RBAC + invalid role), and AI streaming (SSE deltas + done + history persistence). Bypassed Google OAuth by inserting user + user_sessions directly into MongoDB using MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env. Result: 28/28 tests pass when run sequentially (-n 0). Under the default parallel xdist config (-n 2 --dist loadscope), 27/28 pass — a single race condition surfaces because POST /api/dev/seed wipes db.expenses while TestExpenses runs on a different worker; this is a suite-parallelization artifact, not a backend bug (the approve endpoint returns 200 correctly). AI streaming via Gemini 3 Flash preview through EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works end-to-end and messages are persisted in ai_messages.

minor.issue: Destructive: unconditionally wipes donations/expenses/tasks/announcements/events collections with no scoping (e.g., only sample docs or a demo flag). In production this could nuke real data. Consider guarding with an env flag (DEV_SEED_ENABLED) or restricting to a demo/tenant scope.

Session token is stored in Mongo with a 7-day expires_at but Emergent OAuth token itself has its own lifetime; there is no refresh path and no /api/auth/logout invalidation UI test. Behavior looks correct; just flagging for completeness.

action_items: Optional: make POST /api/dev/seed non-destructive (append demo docs with a demo flag, or only allow when env DEMO_MODE=true) so parallel/production runs are safe.
Optional: add a light guard on the seed endpoint to prevent accidental data wipe outside a demo/dev environment.
No frontend testing was requested or performed (testing_type=backend only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file 589 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold but still acceptable for MVP.
Good: MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projection {'_id': 0} and clean() helper.
Good: All URLs/keys read from environment; no hardcoded values.
Good: RBAC enforced via require_role() and returns 403 on unauthorized users (verified for /dev/seed, /members/{id}/role, /expenses/{id}/approve).
Good: session token verified with tz-aware expiry check.
Minor: PATCH /api/tasks/{id} silently drops unknown fields — fine, but a whitelist-based Pydantic model would be cleaner.

Minor: on Emergent OAuth first-user promotion, the count check + insert is not race-safe (two simultaneous first users could both become President). Low risk for a committee app but worth a comment/lock in future.

success_rate.backend: 100% (28/28 sequential; 27/28 under default parallel xdist due to seed race)

seed_data_creation: Tests insert temporary President and Regular Member users + sessions directly into MongoDB (users, user_sessions) with TEST_-prefixed emails and clean them up in session-scope teardown. POST /api/dev/seed is exercised to populate donations/expenses/tasks/announcements/events for dashboard verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth bypass pattern: insert into db.users {user_id, email, name, role, ...} and db.user_sessions {session_token, user_id, expires_at (tz-aware, future)}, then send Authorization: Bearer <session_token>. Roles enforced: President required for /dev/seed; President/VP/Secretary for member role updates; President/Treasurer/VP for expense approve. Backend URL is in frontend/.env as EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Note pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 loadscope — POST /api/dev/seed wipes collections and will race with other classes; run with `-n 0` for deterministic results, or refactor seed to be non-destructive.
rca_of_issue: Single parallel-run failure (TestExpenses.test_approve_as_president under -n 2) — RCA: pytest-xdist loadscope pinned TestExpenses and TestSeedAndDashboard to different workers; POST /api/dev/seed executes `db.expenses.delete_many({})` and wipes the expense created by test_create_expense before test_approve_as_president's verification GET runs. The approve endpoint itself returned 200 (write succeeded, then row was deleted by seed). Mitigation: run `pytest -n 0` (verified: 28/28 pass), or make /api/dev/seed non-destructive/idempotent.
